title: 第21章 他们为什么喊你大炮第22章 不安分的张婶
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
苟总刚刚说完这句话，随后就见一个老汉冲到了李大炮的面前。
“小伙子，总算是等到你了，你这黄什么瓜来着，效果真不错，给我来十根。”
老汉激动地说道，被家里的母老虎欺负了这么多年，昨晚总算是扬眉吐气了一次。
“小伙子，给我也来十根。”
“我也要十根。”
“还有我，给我把这个麻袋装满。”
一个个大老爷们似乎约好了一样，几乎不分先后同时来到李大炮的面前。
“别急别急，今天量大管饱，保证人人有份。”
“那个谁，二狗，你先去把那坨驴粪吃了。”
李大炮开口嘲讽，他赌赢了，昨天给这些人免费试吃了之后，今天果然迎来了开门红。
“怎么可能，这些人都是傻子吗？”
“托，肯定是他的托。”
“不对，听他们说什么来着，这就是比嗷嗷叫更猛的黄龙瓜？”
苟总反应过来了，因为他今天来赶集的目的也是为了买黄龙瓜，只是没想到这是李大炮卖的，而且看起来跟黄瓜差不多，只是更大一些。
“苟总，那坨驴粪似乎还挺新鲜。”
“你们小心点，别踩了驴粪，我们苟总要吃的。”
“苟总，要不要给你准备刀叉餐具？”
几个小弟突然变傻了，似乎觉得愿赌服输，必须得讲信用。
“滚！”
苟总立即发飙，他自然不会这么讲信用，趁着李大炮忙得不可开交，立即开溜。

周念瑶此刻也来到了市场，昨天他们农家乐的生意可以说非常火爆，忙到晚上十二点。
此刻她正揉着自己的腰，四处找李大炮。
“找到了。”
周念瑶双眼放光，她立即挤进了人群，然后赶紧抓住李大炮的手。
“帅哥，我有一笔大买卖，想跟你谈，有没有兴趣跟我走一趟？”
周念瑶送上秋波，为了能够达成合作，似乎都已经准备色诱李大炮。
“大买卖？几个亿的买卖吗？”
李大炮双眼放光的说道，这女人比王美琴更有女人味，同样是个妥妥的极品少妇。
“只要我们长期合作，说不定真有几个亿的买卖哦。”
周念瑶笑道，原本她还想调戏一下李大炮，没想到先被他给调戏了。
“我这边暂时走不开。”
“别卖了，你这里才卖10块钱一斤，我给你50块钱一斤。”
“50块钱一斤？”
李大炮眼前一亮，这还有什么好说的，立即收摊，然后跟着她走了。
能卖出这个价格，以后私房钱都能藏一大笔，保证不会让孟晚晴发现。
“帅哥，你真的叫李大炮？”
周念瑶问道，李大炮看起来斯斯文文的样子，这名字却有点出类拔萃。
“我真名叫李风，大炮是我的外号，村里人都这么喊我。”李大炮回道。
“这样啊，你们村的人为什么喊你大炮？”
周念瑶一脸好奇，她在李大炮身上打量了一下，最后聚焦在他裤子上有些夸张的轮廓，似乎有些明白了。

这让她芳心一颤，立即红了脸。
“可能是我打炮比较厉害吧。”李大炮憨憨的回道。
content_en:
Just as Mr. Gou finished saying this, he saw an old man rushing in front of Li Dapao.
"Young man, I finally waited for you. What a yellow melon you are. The effect is really good. Give me ten."
The old man said excitedly that after being bullied by the tigress at home for so many years, he finally felt proud last night.
"Young man, give me ten too."
"I want ten too."
"And me, fill this sack for me."
All the big men seemed to have made an appointment, and they came to Li Dapao at the same time almost in no particular order.
"Don't be impatient, don't be impatient, today's food will be generous and enough will be provided to ensure that everyone has a share."
"Who is that? Ergou, go ahead and eat that donkey dung."
Li Dapao taunted, he won the bet, and after giving these people a free trial yesterday, today really got off to a good start.
"How is it possible? Are these people all fools?"
"Trust, it must be his trust."
"No, listen to what they are saying, is this the yellow dragon melon that screams more fiercely than the squealing one?"
Mr. Gou came to his senses, because he came to the market today to buy yellow dragon melons, but he didn't expect that they were sold by Li Dapao, and they looked similar to cucumbers, only bigger.
"Mr. Gou, that donkey dung seems to be quite fresh."
"Be careful and don't step on donkey manure. We will always have something to eat."
"Mr. Gou, do you want to prepare cutlery and cutlery for you?"
The younger brothers suddenly became stupid and seemed to think that if they were willing to admit defeat, they had to be trustworthy.
"Get out!"
Mr. Gou immediately became furious. Naturally, he would not be so trustworthy. He immediately ran away while Li Dapao was busy.
Zhou Nianyao also came to the market at this moment. The business of their farmhouse was very hot yesterday, and they were busy until twelve o'clock in the evening.
At this moment, she was rubbing her waist and looking around for Li Dapao.
"Found it."
Zhou Nianyao's eyes shone, and she immediately squeezed into the crowd, and then quickly grabbed Li Dapao's hand.
"Handsome guy, I have a big deal that I want to discuss with you. Are you interested in coming with me?"
Zhou Nianyao looked at Li Dapao and seemed to be ready to seduce Li Dapao in order to achieve cooperation.
"Big deal? A deal worth hundreds of millions?"
Li Dapao said with shining eyes, this woman is more feminine than Wang Meiqin, and she is also a perfect young woman.
"As long as we cooperate for a long time, we might be able to do business worth hundreds of millions."
Zhou Nianyao smiled and said, originally she wanted to tease Li Dapao, but she didn't expect to be teased by him first.
"I can't leave here for now."
"Don't sell it. You only sell it here for 10 yuan per catty. I'll give you 50 yuan per catty."
"50 yuan per pound?"
Li Dapao's eyes lit up. What else could he say? He immediately closed the stall and followed her.
If you can sell it at this price, you can hide a large amount of private money in the future, ensuring that Meng Wanqing will not find out.
"Handsome guy, is your name really Li Dapao?"
Zhou Nianyao asked, Li Dapao looked gentle and polite, but his name was a bit outstanding.
"My real name is Li Feng, Dapao is my nickname, and everyone in the village calls me that." Li Dapao replied.
"Well, why do people in your village call you Cannon?"
Zhou Nianyao looked curious. She looked at Li Dapao, and finally focused on the exaggerated outline of his trousers, and she seemed to understand.
This made her heart tremble and she immediately blushed.
"Maybe it's because I'm better at sex." Li Dapao replied naively.
